verdict.rationale: Cua's first-party docs say Cua Driver lets an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux "through MCP or a CLI." They also say you install it once and add it to agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, which amounts to an official MCP server that agents connect to. The documentation is brief, though: missing for 10: a documented MCP tool catalog and configuration details, coverage of MCP access beyond the Driver (e.g. Spaces/SDK), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP integration.
